title: White-Haired Sorceress Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a dark-skinned woman with long flowing white hair, wearing a red and black outfit with a long coat and boots. She dynamically casts glowing red magical energy that intensifies from rings around her arms to explosive red sparks and finally to swirling white and red smoke.
prompt: A dark-skinned female character with long flowing white hair in four sequential action poses against a dark gray background. She wears a sleeveless red coat with black pants and red boots. In the first pose she summons red magical rings around her arms, then runs forward with energy trails, then punches with an explosive red spark burst, and finally releases swirling red and white smoke from her hands in a powerful stance.
